title: Night screen prototype
summary: Restores the earlier presentation outside Night and previews a new assignment-led Night screen.
changes: The broad 37.70 presentation treatment has been rolled back on Changes, Breaks, Chat, Account and the full roster, while the existing app stack and behavior remain intact.
Night now puts its selected date, personal role, working period, break and colleague ahead of a concise staffing state.
Team allocation is available on demand below the brief, with a calmer light and dark treatment and the existing navigation gestures.
